name: go-containerregistry-refreshable-backing-b322
instr:
go-containerregistry cannot refresh long-lived Image values backed by mutable sources without changing the established Image contract. Add in-place refresh with stable generation identities and coherent snapshots.

Refreshable daemon, mutated, schema1, and remote images must atomically replace metadata, configuration, layers, and derived state while keeping acquired generations readable. Concurrent refreshes share one source attempt. Cancelling one waiter affects only that waiter unless all cancel. Failed or abandoned attempts leave the last generation readable and retryable. Results distinguish unchanged, advanced, failed, and cancelled attempts with comparable before and after identities.

Daemon refresh reacquires inspection and export state together. Mutated images reflect refreshed bases in every derived value while retaining addenda and overrides. Schema1 refresh advances legacy state without relaxing unsupported operations. Remote refresh reacquires the original reference with its context, authentication, platform, transport, puller options, and media-type constraints. Preserve daemon buffering, mutation artifact handling, schema1 limitations, and default pull behavior.

Pin one generation throughout push, write, copy, and validation. Propagate refresh or publication failures. Never publish or diagnose mixed-generation state. Crane pull opts into refreshability through `WithRefreshable` from `github.com/google/go-containerregistry/pkg/crane`; its default remains unchan
